title: Fix build/deployment failure and restore Live camera capture/recording

requirements.text: Fix the frontend build error preventing deployment by resolving the missing import used by the camera recording UI (the hook imported as `@/camera/useCamera`). Add the missing `useCamera` hook/module (or update the import to a real existing module) so the app compiles and the Live page can render the Camera Recording tab.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/live/CameraCaptureRecorderCard.tsx` no longer imports a non-existent module path.
Frontend builds successfully with no TypeScript module-resolution errors related to `@/camera/useCamera`.
Navigating to the Live page and switching to the "Camera Recording" tab renders without a blank screen or runtime crash.

requirements.text: Implement camera start/stop behavior in the `useCamera` hook so that clicking "Enable Camera" requests permissions via `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`, attaches the stream to the provided `videoRef`, and surfaces user-friendly errors for common failures (permission denied, no camera device found, not supported).
acceptanceCriteria: On a supported browser, clicking "Enable Camera" shows a live preview in the `<video>` element.
If permission is denied, the UI shows the existing English message: "Camera permission denied. Please allow camera access to continue."
If no camera is available, the UI shows the existing English message: "No camera found. Please connect a camera device."
Clicking "Stop Camera" stops all MediaStream tracks and the preview stops.

requirements.text: Fix any TypeScript DOM typing issues in `useMediaRecorder` that can break the frontend build in a browser-only React project (e.g., avoid using `NodeJS.Timeout` for `setInterval` in the browser) so the hook type-checks cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/hooks/useMediaRecorder.ts` type-checks without relying on `NodeJS` timer types.
Frontend builds successfully with strict TypeScript settings used by the project.
Recording start/stop still works and produces a playable `recordedUrl` in the camera recording UI.

constraints: Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts` / `.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or anything in `frontend/src/components/ui` (immutable paths).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not add backend APIs for uploading/storing video recordings; recordings remain local in the browser as described on the Live page.
Do not implement real-time streaming, WebSockets, or server-side video processing.
